title: PenguinJpeg
description: Ever wanted more penguins in Minecraft? Too bad.
body:
A resource pack by me that literally just replaces all the textures I can find the time to replace with a single penguin image. The eventual goal is to replace every single texture in the game, making it a true penguin experience.

I’m sorry.

## GitHub Download Instructions (v3.0+)
1. Click the "GitHub" link below.
2. Find the button on the side that says "Releases" and click it.
3. Click on the top file of the highest entry on the list, which will be named "PenguinJpeg-<version>.zip".
4. Copy the file to your "resourcepacks" folder.

# EDIT:
**As of v3.0, this pack is too big for Modrinth. Therefore, you'll have to download it straight from GitHub. Sorry for any inconcenience this may cause.**
